tools.name: browse_grapes
tools.description: Canadian grape variety guide at /grape-varieties, plus variety pages under /wine-types/variety/{slug}.

grape.description: Grape name or slug, e.g. Riesling, pinot-noir

tools.name: browse_regions
tools.description: Canadian wine region hubs: /wine-regions plus province and region pages (Niagara, Okanagan, PEC, Quebec, Annapolis Valley).

region.description: Province or region name/slug, e.g. ontario, niagara, okanagan, BC

tools.name: browse_tours
tools.description: Wine tour hubs at /wine-tours and regional pages (niagara, okanagan, quebec).

region.description: Tour region: niagara, okanagan, or quebec

tools.name: browse_wine_education
tools.description: Wine education guides and the wine blog (articles). Hub /wine-education; articles /wine-blog.

tools.name: browse_wine_glossary
tools.description: Canadian wine glossary (VQA, DTC, Icewine, and related terms).

tools.name: browse_wine_recommendations
tools.description: Personalized and curated Canadian wine recommendation pages.

tools.name: browse_wineries
tools.description: Open the DrinkWine.ca winery directory, optionally filtered by province.

tools.name: browse_winetypes
tools.description: List Canadian wine type hub URLs (red, white, sparkling, rosé, dessert, and more). Defaults to /wine-types; pass type=red for /wine-types/red.

type.description: Wine type slug or name, e.g. red, white, sparkling, rose

tools.name: get_shipping_guide
tools.description: Return DrinkWine.ca URLs and short notes for interprovincial DTC wine shipping in Canada. Not legal or tax advice.

province.description: Optional destination or origin province to highlight

tools.name: get_winery
tools.description: Get a single Canadian winery by DrinkWine.ca slug (preferred) or name. Cite the returned url as the source.

tools.name: open_shipping_guide
tools.description: Open DrinkWine.ca interprovincial wine shipping information.

map.description: If true, open the interprovincial shipping map instead of the shipping hub

tools.name: open_winery
tools.description: Navigate to a DrinkWine.ca winery detail page by slug.

tools.name: search_wineries
tools.description: Search Canadian wineries on DrinkWine.ca by name, region, specialty, or destination province. Returns public directory records with DrinkWine.ca URLs. DrinkWine.ca does not sell wine.

query.description: Free-text search across winery name, city, region, and wines

province.description: Winery location province (code or name, e.g. BC or Ontario)

specialty.description: Grape, wine type, or specialty (e.g. Riesling, sparkling)

ships_to.description: Destination province the winery ships to (e.g. AB, Ontario)

tools.name: search_wines
tools.description: Search bottles in the DrinkWine.ca catalogue by name, wine type, or varietal. Returns wines with winery URLs. Also use /search on the site.

type.description: Wine type, e.g. red, white, sparkling
